name: Sunset Sherbet
summary: **Sunset Sherbet** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by Mario Guzman, known as Sherbinski, in the San Francisco Bay Area around 2014. It arose from an accidental cross of a [[thin-mint-gsc|Thin Mint GSC]] phenotype and a [[pink-panties|Pink Panties]] male plant. The resulting cut later became a parent of [[gelato|Gelato]].

sources.title: The Sherbinski Sitdown: A Comprehensive Guide to Gelato
